span.label: Measurement of equity risk premia, treated as a prediction problem, across the machine learning method repertoire.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: How do machine learning methods compare for the canonical problem of empirical asset pricing, measuring asset risk premia?
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Provides benchmarks for the predictive accuracy of machine learning methods in measuring risk premia, robust across specifications.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the sample is cut into three disjoint periods that keep the data's time ordering: the model is estimated on the training period alone, while the hyperparameters are chosen by scoring forecasts on the second period and re-estimating from the training data at every step
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the third period is used for neither estimation nor tuning, which is what makes it the only one of the three that is truly out of sample - the validation fits are not, because they are an input to the estimation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the out-of-sample R-squared is computed against a forecast of zero rather than against the historical mean return, because the historical mean of an individual stock is so noisy that benchmarking against it would lower the bar - and the paper states the size of the choice: every method's monthly R-squared rises by roughly three percentage points under the conventional denominator
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the Diebold-Mariano comparison is applied to the cross-sectional AVERAGE of each month's prediction errors rather than to individual stock errors, because the test's weak-dependence condition is unlikely to hold across a cross-section of stocks with potentially strong dependence
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the network architectures are fixed in advance instead of searched over, because searching uncountably many is called unrealistic and unnecessary - and what the authors say they hope to obtain is a reasonable LOWER BOUND on machine-learning performance, not the best network
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the squared-error objective is replaced by a hybrid of squared loss for relatively small errors and absolute loss for relatively large ones, with the crossover controlled by a tuning parameter optimised adaptively from the data
span.note: about this quote: Q-609, 2026-08-16: THE EXTRACTION HAS STRIPPED THE MATH SYMBOLS INSIDE THIS QUOTE. It reads "The Huber loss, H(?), is a hybrid ... controlled by a tuning parameter, , that can be optimized adaptively" - the argument of H and the NAME OF THE TUNING PARAMETER are both absent from the staged file, leaving a bare comma where the symbol was. The quote is an exact substring and the file is incomplete here. The tag deliberately describes the parameter by its role rather than naming it, because naming it would mean supplying a character the staged text does not contain.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: trees in the forest are de-correlated by offering each branch only a randomly drawn subset of the predictors, so that a single dominant predictor cannot force the same early split in every bootstrap sample and collapse the variance reduction that averaging is supposed to provide
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the network is estimated from several different random initialisations and the forecasts are averaged, because the optimiser is stochastic and a single seed's forecast carries variance that has nothing to do with the data
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the interpretation of which methods win is checked against two simulated data sets whose generating processes are known - one linear and additive, one nonlinear with pairwise interactions - so that the ranking can be shown to track the property it is being credited to
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The headline R2 uses a denominator without demeaning; the paper states the common alternative convention raises every method's R2 by roughly three percentage points.
span.note: what this limits: comparing this paper's R2 against an R2 computed the usual way, against historical mean returns: the paper says that convention raises all its numbers by roughly three percentage points
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The paper states its improved predictions are measurements only, and do not identify economic mechanisms or equilibria.
span.note: what this limits: reading the results as evidence about economic mechanisms: the paper says the measurements do not tell us about mechanisms or equilibria
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The set of methods compared is explicitly not exhaustive, and support vector machines are excluded with a stated reason.
span.note: what this limits: reading the comparison as covering the machine learning toolkit: the paper says it is not exhaustive and names an exclusion
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The paper describes its own interpretive goal as modest.
span.note: what this limits: reading the variable-importance results as an account of why a predictor works: the stated goal is only to identify influential covariates
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The conditions underlying the Diebold-Mariano test are stated to be unlikely to hold for the stock-level analysis; the paper modifies the test rather than proceeding.
span.note: what this limits: the reported model-comparison p-values as standard Diebold-Mariano results: the test was adapted because its conditions were judged unlikely to hold
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The predictor literature the study draws on is stated to exclude an unknown larger set of predictors that were tested, failed and never reported.
span.note: what this limits: the 900+ signal set as the space of tested predictors: the paper says an unknown larger set failed and was never reported
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The finding that shallow networks beat deeper ones is attributed, with hedging, to the data available rather than established as a property of the problem.
span.note: what this limits: generalising shallow-beats-deep beyond this setting: the paper attributes it, hedged, to the small data and low signal-to-noise ratio here
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The estimation target is defined in terms of an information set the paper calls true and unobservable.
span.note: what this limits: treating the target as an observable quantity: the conditioning information set is stated to be unobservable
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The paper's central term is stated to have no settled definition, and the definition used is stipulated by the authors.
span.note: what this limits: reading "machine learning" here as a standard term: the paper says the definition is inchoate and stipulates its own three-part one
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the architecture and vocabulary of the biological nervous system - neurons, synapses, axons, signals passed between layers - carried into empirical asset pricing as the description of a feed-forward network
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: parameter penalisation and deliberately conservative model-selection criteria applied across the whole method comparison
span.note: eliminates: overfitting and false discovery as the source of apparent predictive power - the flexible functional forms being compared can fit noise, and without the penalty the comparison would reward whichever method fits it best
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: qualifies → Green et al. (2013), Harvey et al. (2016), Welch and Goyal (2008) — the predictor-counting literature
span.note: differs in: WHETHER THE COUNT IS OF PREDICTORS OR OF REPORTED PREDICTORS. Three surveys are cited with their totals - 330 stock-level signals, 316 factors, nearly 20 aggregate-market predictors - and then: 'Quotation withheld.' The denominator of the search is unobservable, so the counts bound the published literature and not the work done
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: builds-on → Welch and Goyal (2008)
span.note: differs in: WHAT THE BENCHMARK IS. The comparison point is not a rival method's success but a documented FAILURE: 'nearly all of the macroeconomic return predictor variables in the survey of Welch and Goyal (2008) Quotation withheld.' A negative result is doing the work of a baseline, which is only legible if the reader knows the sign convention of this R2 - and the record already carries two senses of it
